product_desc: The Acer One 14 Z8-415-A is a notebook computer featuring an 11th Gen Intel Core processor, a 14-inch Full HD display, and typically comes with 8GB RAM and a 512GB SSD. It runs on Windows 11 and includes various connectivity options and an HD webcam with a privacy shutter. It is also ENERGY STAR certified.
